For a 30-day trip, you'll need an e-Visa — the visa-free exemption for Filipino passport holders only covers up to 21 days, so your 30-day stay exceeds it.

E-Visa details:
- Allows stays of up to 90 days
- Cost: USD 25 (single entry) or USD 50 (multiple entry)
- Apply at https://evisa.gov.vn/
- Processing takes about 2-3 business days (faster options available for a higher fee)
- Valid for entry by air, land, or sea at any of the approved ports (no need to nominate a single port)

Other requirement: your passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your date of entry.

Note: this is based on data as of 2026-08-17 — double-check the current rules at evisa.gov.vn before you travel, since policy can change.
